verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability, such as multi-select edits, batch status updates, or batch MCP tools that act on many items in one call. The MCP server covers per-item actions: listing audits and evidence requests, and adding comments or status updates to evidence requests. Shared controls, unified action items, and cross-workspace user-access management are adjacent features that reduce duplicate work, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
